leadText:
Lake Psyduck is an -exclusive location in Sinnoh featured in The Psyduck Stops Here!. It is located between Solaceon Town and Celestic Town.

The lake appears to be shaped like a 's foot. It is surrounded by many kinds of .

Several Psyduck retreated from the lake after a group of took over, resulting in them blocking a road so that three Psyduck s could hatch without disturbance. and helped in driving the Muk away so that the Psyduck could live by the lake and stop blocking the road. The Muk were sent flying and landed in a nearby lake, which was polluted and home to other Muk.
